newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 16.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 16.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Tamas Isepy, parliament speaker of the opposition Christian-Democrat People's Party (KDNP) may be sacked from this post over his disagreement with KDNP xresident Gyorgy Giczy.
- A committee of the assembly of Budapest does not agree with the proposal of Interior Minister Gabor Kuncze for appointing an officer from the town Szekesfehervar as police chief of the capital.
- Gyorgy Habsburg, son of Otto Habsburg has been appointed as Hungary's ambassador at large for helping the country's integration in the European Union.
- A submachine-gun was yesterday stolen from a soldier, who had fallen asleep on sentry-duty.
